# Evolution log

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-evolution-log.mjs from data/evolution-log.json; do not edit by hand. -->

This library rewrites its own weakest skills. A model proposes a rewrite, a judge scores it against the original, and only a clear win is kept. A person still reviews the pull request before anything merges. Every attempt is recorded here, **including the ones that lost**, so the claim "the skills improve themselves" can be checked line by line.

**1 attempt** on 1 skill: 1 kept, 0 rejected, average gain when kept +0.25 (1–5 rubric). [Browse it on the site](https://mohitagw15856.github.io/pm-claude-skills/evolution.html).

The loops: `self-improve`, Self-improve; `evolve`, Evolve (blind champion vs challenger); `improve`, Improve (critique and rewrite). They run when the maintainer dispatches them; the evolve loop also runs monthly once the repository variable `EVOLVE_MONTHLY` is set to `true`.
